map.已决赔款与保费之比 使用指南: Incurred Claims to Premium Ratio User Guide
map.赔付率计算器。输入赔款支出与保费收入，按 赔付率 = 赔款/保费 求赔付率，用于: Loss ratio calculator. Enter claims paid and premium income and compute the loss ratio as claims / premium, for insurance business quality and underwriting profitability analysis.
map.赔付率 = 赔款支出 ÷ 保费收入。: Loss ratio = claims paid ÷ premium income.
map.看保费里多少赔出去了，是承保质量核心。: See how much of the premium is paid out in claims, the core of underwriting quality.
map.和费用率相加得综合成本率。: Add to the expense ratio to get the combined ratio.
map.：赔付率 = 650/1000 = 65%。即每 1 元保费赔出 0.65 元。: : loss ratio = 650/1000 = 65%. That is, 0.65 of every 1 unit of premium is paid out in claims.
map.一次性缴清的纯保费: Net premium paid as a single amount
map.已决和已发生赔付率差？: Difference between incurred and occurred loss ratios?
map.已决只看已结；已发生含 IBNR 更全。发展早期已决偏低、随理赔成熟上升。: Incurred counts only settled claims; incurred-but-not-reported is fuller in the 'occurred' measure. Early in development incurred runs low and rises as claims mature.
map.赔付率 70% 算好还是坏？: Is a 70% loss ratio good or bad?
map.单看赔付率不够。70% 赔付率加25% 费用率等于95% 综合成本率（承保微利）: Loss ratio alone is not enough. A 70% loss ratio plus a 25% expense ratio gives a 95% combined ratio (thin underwriting profit); but with high expenses, 70% can still break through. You must read the combined ratio together with the expense ratio.
